Blink.name: Blink
Blink.description: Caster fades away in a manner of their choice, teleporting up to their current movement somewhere else in their LOS.

Chain Lightning.name: Chain Lightning
Chain Lightning.description: Caster fires a massive arc of lightning from their fingertips towards a target. Chain lightning inflicts 7 + 1/2F d20 lightning damage, HEA save for half - jumping to a new target of the caster's choice within 20' of the original target should they fail the save. The chain repeats itself until the caster ends it, or the HEA save is successfully made; in all cases, the lightning cannot jump back to targets that have already been struck.

Cloak of Storms.name: Cloak of Storms
Cloak of Storms.description: Caster covers the willing target in a thick layer of elemental energy, damaging other targets within 10' + 5'/2F of them for 2 + 1/4F d10 lightning damage at the end of their turn. This spell also grants the target lightning resistance.

Favor of the Wind.name: Favor of the Wind
Favor of the Wind.description: Willing targets within one size category of the caster may be forcibly shifted 10' + 5'/2F in a direction of the caster's choice. If this is enough to take a character outside of a weapon's reach, range, or area of effect's space, the ability does not affect the character.

Flash.name: Flash
Flash.description: Numerous jolts of lightning fly out from the caster's fingertips. The caster makes 3 + 1/2F ranged attack rolls, inflicting 2d8 lightning damage on each successful strike.

Gathering Winds.name: Gathering Winds
Gathering Winds.description: Caster shrouds themselves in air, increasing their movement speed by 50' + 10'/F. Immediately upon casting this spell, and then as a Swift Action during later rounds, sweeps up anyone they move adjacent to, causing them to lose their movement actions and reactions - as they are forced to follow the whirlwind 10' behind the caster, STR, or AGI check to negate (target's choice.) Affected targets can re-attempt with a swift action.

Gathering Storm.name: Gathering Storm
Gathering Storm.description: A symbol of the caster's choice appears over the targets. For every 10' the target moves, they receive 1d8 lightning damage, and the caster builds up a Static Charge for every 10' the target moves. When the caster has built 5 charges they may cast Lightning Bolt as a Swift Action or cast Chain Lightning as a Core Action upon building up 10 charges. These spells do not cost mana when cast this way.

Forceful Winds.name: Forceful Winds
Forceful Winds.area: Object smaller or equal to 4000 lbs
Forceful Winds.description:
Caster gains the ability to move or manipulate targets with the force of air. Immediately upon casting this spell, and then as a core action during all later turns the caster can grip a target, STR check to negate. The caster can shift their grip to a different target on each of their turns, though they may only grip up to 1 + 1/2F targets at once. As a swift action, the caster can do the following to all gripped targets. 
Move them 60' in any direction, inflicting 4d10 blunt damage on collision though the effect immediately ends upon leaving the LOS. 
Carefully and forcefully manipulate inanimate objects. The caster can make ranged attack rolls with these objects, inflicting 3 + 1/2F d12 piercing, blunt, or edged damage (As appropriate) on hit. 
While held by the caster's grip, the targets are pinned. Affected targets can re-attempt with a swift action.

Hawksoar.name: Hawksoar
Hawksoar.description: Magical energy propels the targets. They gain a magical flying speed of 60' + 10'/F or a magical flying speed equal to their land movement speed - whichever is higher.

Lightning Bolt.name: Lightning Bolt
Lightning Bolt.description: A massive bolt of lightning flies from the caster's fingertips in a line, inflicting 4 + 1/F d12 lightning damage, HEA save for half damage.

Lightning Cascade.name: Lightning Cascade
Lightning Cascade.description: Dangerous storms form overhead. The caster makes 3 + 1/2F separate rolls to hit, as a series of lightning bolts strike a target. Each bolt inflicts 2d20 lightning damage on hit.

One with the Wind.name: One with the Wind
One with the Wind.description: For the duration of the spell, the caster can choose to dematerialize and subsequently materialize up to their move speed somewhere else in their LOS, immediately upon casting this spell and then as a Swift Action during all later turns. Upon materializing, those within a 10' radius of the caster receive 2d10 lightning damage.

Thunderlink.name: Thunderlink
Thunderlink.description: WIL An electric trail forms, linking all targets in the area. When a linked target ends its turn in the area, it receives 1 + 1/2F d20 lightning damage, HEA save for half. When a linked target leaves the area by any means, they are stunned, HEA save to negate.

Thundering Steel.name: Thundering Steel
Thundering Steel.description: Caster produces ammunition for a ranged weapon or edges a melee weapon with magic. Enchanted weapons that miss its attack on a target under this spell's effect inflicts 1 + 1/4F d8 lightning damage for each attack missed (Cumulative for each attack missed), HEA save to negate the damage.

Voltspike.name: Voltspike
Voltspike.description: Caster fires an arc of lightning from their fingertips, making a ranged attack roll and inflicting (Rank/2)d10 of lightning damage to the target on hit.

Warp Lightning.name: Warp Lightning
Warp Lightning.description: Caster binds magical air to themselves. While bound by this force, each time a target fails a save/check associated with an aeromancy spell or is successfully struck by an attack roll emanating from aeromancy the target is forcibly pushed to a new location within 40' of their original location (Chosen by the caster.)

Wind Wall.name: Wind Wall
Wind Wall.description: This spell creates a swirling wall of air. Projectiles moving through the wind wall remove 3 dice from their attack roll. Targets moving through the wall make a STR or AGI check (target's choice) and on a failure stop moving, lose all remaining movement, and fall prone. Caster can move the wall 10' in any direction as a Swift Action.

Zephyr.name: Zephyr
Zephyr.description: Caster creates a massive gust that can move people, objects, blow away clouds, and snuff out a house-sized fire. Objects up to 40 + 5/F lbs can be moved up to 60' per round in the direction of the airflow. Targets are pushed 20' in the direction of the gust and knocked prone at the end of each of the caster's turns, STR check to negate. Caster can change the direction of the zephyr as a Swift Action.
